title: record.json — completed-record (local bundles)
description: Written by the record verb in scripts/review.sh for local and provider-PR bundles (GitHub PRs use post). findings/open are recomputed from the merged store every run; confidence/security_summary are null when the review carried none. additionalProperties stays open for additive provenance fields.

status.description: Bundle provider that was recorded (e.g. local).

head.description: Reviewed SHA (real head_sha, or "dirty"/"unknown" when the bundle has none).

diff_sha256.description: SHA-256 of full.diff at record time.

recorded_at.description: UTC timestamp of the record run.
